description: Change of use from existing 3-bedroom dwellinghouse to Childrens Residential Care Home (Use Class C2) for a maximum of 2 children with carers
decision_conditions: The proposal for a change of use from a residential dwelling (Use Class C3), to a children's home (C2) would be contrary to Policy 6 (i) of the Havering Local Plan as there is no identified need within the borough for additional places. As there is no identified need, the proposal results in the unacceptable loss of a residential dwelling, which is contrary to Policy 3 (xi) of the Havering Local Plan.

The proposed office for the children's home (C2) use would be unsuitable terms of the standard of facilities for the provision of support and/or care and would be contrary to Policy 6 (v) of the Havering Local Plan.

The proposed development due to its inadequate on-site car parking provision would likely result in unacceptable overspill onto surrounding roads, causing harm to highway safety and residential amenity, and contrary to Policies to Havering Local Plan Policies 6 (ix) (x), 23 and 24, London Plan Policies T4, T6 and the NPPF (2021).

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Mark Mirams (Agent) by e-mail on 10/08/26.
